description: Land Title Settlement Department - Siddhamulla, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520020
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 45 of Block 06) with detailed particulars including ownership details, extent of land, property classifications, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
